style: Flat vector educational illustration for children aged 9 to 15. Clean even outlines, flat fills, white background, plenty of empty margin around the subject. Palette: blues and teals (#7BAFD4 to #4A9AA8 with darker outlines of the same hue) plus exactly one warm orange accent (#F5A04A) used for the single most important part. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows with text, no gradients, no drop shadows, no 3D rendering, no photographic texture.
negative: text, letters, digits, captions, watermark, signature, gradient, shadow, 3D, photo, cartoon face, extra limbs
common_checklist: anatomy_structure: the parts of the subject are present, in the right places and in the right proportions for a school textbook; nothing important is missing or invented
no_text: there is no text, letter, digit or label anywhere in the image (a symbol such as an arrow is fine)
palette: flat fills in blue/teal with at most one orange accent, white background, no gradients or shadows

repeated_elements: every element that is meant to repeat (cells, nucleosomes, petals, chambers) is drawn identically in shape and colour; only a deliberately highlighted one may differ, and then it must be the orange accent for a stated reason
clean_edges: nothing is cut off at the image border; the subject is centred with margin
